applicable_to: arXiv-style preprints, surveys, or any venue without a specific required class — a plain fallback.
notes: Class is part of the base LaTeX format, always available. No specific citation style enforced. main.tex is a real filled-in illustrative survey paper (compression techniques for on-device language models) rather than placeholder text, deliberately written in survey structure (taxonomy of approaches, comparison table across a whole field) rather than the single-method experimental structure used by the other seed templates, matching this template's survey paper_type. Contains 3 real matplotlib-generated figures: accuracy-vs-compression-ratio and latency-vs-compression-ratio scatter plots in Comparison, plus a grouped bar chart of surveyed-papers-per-year in the Introduction motivating the survey's scope. Generic_Article_Template.pdf is a kept compiled reference render, excluded from get_template_files like all PDFs. Verified to compile cleanly with zero Overfull/Underfull warnings.
